evidence: Canonical derived-object cleanup now passes the previewed file candidate into an internal delete operation, rechecks retention/reference/reader state inside the metadata transaction, acquires the exact preview generation through a held Windows handle, verifies content through that same handle, and performs rename and deletion through it. A deleted-and-republished same-digest generation is skipped and retained.

The prior reference, active-reader, hardlink, path-authority, one-time preview, audit, quota, low-disk, and restart barriers remain covered. The deterministic republish test proves zero reclaimed, one skipped, retained metadata, and readable replacement bytes.

Immutable Windows cleanup API bindings are cached once per process without weakening per-candidate identity validation. The first ten-sample registered run passed with roughly 476 ms of regression-threshold headroom.

The exact 83-test affected union covers fresh and migrated v5 schemas, rollback failpoints, repositories, plaintext/encrypted publication, prior-envelope upgrade and restart, rights and egress denial, injected access-policy decisions, stale cleanup previews, audit/quota/low-disk behavior, and strict contracts.

Direct access-policy tests prove unknown remote-egress, wrong access class, missing destination, default controlled-egress denial, require-confirmation, and policy exceptions expose no reader. An injected exact allow permits only the declared controlled-egress request and records its detached metadata and destination.
The real frozen package, 166 foundation tests, 21 security tests, supply-chain scan, and ten-sample Windows performance authority all passed the remediated surface.

ObjectPutCommand and StoredObject now carry a closed technical creation-source category. New puts must explicitly use local-import, connector-acquisition, local-derivation, or test-fixture; legacy-unreported is reserved for truthful migration backfill and is not represented as scholarly provenance.

Governed migration 0005 advances exact v4 to v5 after a verified backup, preserves v1-v4 fingerprints and history, backfills legacy-unreported, and produces the same exact schema fingerprint as fresh v5 initialization. Recovery schemas, SQLite/object-store profiles, docs, tests, quality inventory, and frozen-package inventory were updated.

The dependency-neutral ObjectAccessPolicy seam classifies known local reads and controlled egress. The default allows only known local reads and denies controlled egress before path resolution or decryption; only an exact bounded allow decision can expose a stream. CAP-02.S04 can inject the settings/consent-backed policy without importing private adapter state.

verificationSelection.riskAnalysis: The slice-review remediation spans destructive Windows I/O, a preview-generation race, schema migration/history, a public dependency-neutral object-store contract, privacy/egress enforcement, packaging, and the benchmark implementation. The selected checks therefore cover the exact affected 83-test data union, v1-v4 migration and rollback, strict contracts, real frozen packaging, all foundation/security tests, the supply-chain scan, and the full registered ten-sample Windows storage gate. The first full security-profile attempt honestly stopped after 276.48 seconds at foundation:quality because v0005 was absent from quality-scope.json; all earlier commands passed. That omission was corrected in the sole follow-up commit d0cebec, after which the quality check and every remaining profile command passed at exact final head.
